positions.title: Web Applications Analyst
positions.description:
•	Led development of an internal Order Management System (OMS) for a Ship from Store program that allows orders to be fulfilled from store inventory when the fulfillment center is out of stock

•	Worked with technical resources at Cardinal Solutions to develop and implement web services for a new SharePoint portal

•	Developed middleware for a Point-of-Sale (POS) program that allows customers to make an online order at the same time as their in-store purchase

•	Coordinated code reviews and release management for monthly e-commerce builds

•	Wrote back-end systems for key functionality on The Limited’s e-commerce website:
	Apply & Buy – allows customers to apply for a private label credit card and immediately use it for their online purchase.
	An all-in-one promotional code box that queries multiple back-end systems concurrently.
	Integration with ShopRunner China to allow Chinese customers to check out with their Alipay account.

•	Provided 24x7 technical and functional support of The Limited’s e-commerce and store integration systems

•	Managed settings and configurations in Demandware’s Business Manager application

positions.title: Web Developer II
positions.description:
•	Developed web services and databases for a Reserve Online program that allows customers to reserve items in a store and pick them up at their convenience.  Integrated with Twilio to text customers updates about their reservation.

•	Integrated ShopRunner into The Limited’s e-commerce website to allow customers to receive free two-day shipping with their membership

•	Created automated XML and CSV product feeds to various third party e-commerce vendors

•	Created a centralized location for e-commerce promotion codes and wrote web services to check code balances, redeem codes and void code redemptions

•	Wrote a Markdown Tool used by store associates to take pricing markdowns on store inventory

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Created a Product Inventory Management tool that allows merchants and copywriters to create and modify product data which is then used to update content on the website

•	Wrote additional store operational reports which gave corporate and store associates the ability to view raw store data by various levels of the company hierarchy

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
•	Wrote Visual Basic macros in Microsoft Excel to query a DB2 sales and traffic database, call web services and validate data

•	Created an Adobe Flex module for an internal Store Portal

•	Optimized and debugged existing Java web services used for accessing staffing data
